quarterly_data.quarter: Wärtsilä press release: Wrtsil to supply 282 MW onsite power solution for a U.S. (10-05-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Data-center order (release): Wärtsilä secured an order to supply a 282 MW onsite power solution with 15 Wärtsilä 50SG engines for a data center project being developed by a major US independent power producer (not named); booked in Q3 2026, equipment delivery scheduled for 2028 and the project expected to be fully operational in 2029. It is Wärtsilä's seventh data center-related order in the United States, bringing the total power capacity it has sold for U.S. data center applications to more than 3 GW.
quarterly_data.figure: 282 MW; 15 Wärtsilä 50SG engines; seventh U.S. data center order; more than 3 GW sold for U.S. data centers
